title: longfellow-vectors mdoc certificate vector, v1
description: Sidecar for a PEM certificate under vectors/mdoc/certificates/.

role.description: Position in the ISO 18013-5 trust chain.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sibling .pem file's bytes.

public_key_x.description: Affine coordinate x of the certificate's SubjectPublicKeyInfo P-256 key, lowercase hex. Omitted when the PEM does not parse or the key is not EC P-256.

public_key_y.description: Affine coordinate y of the certificate's SubjectPublicKeyInfo P-256 key, lowercase hex. Omitted when the PEM does not parse or the key is not EC P-256.

signed_by.description: Vector name of the certificate whose key signed this one. Present only when that signature verified at write time.

key.description: Vector name of the key vector this certificate certifies. Present only when the certificate's SubjectPublicKeyInfo matched that key vector at write time.
